description.en: Delivers the core's and other plugins' notifications by email over SMTP (notification channel "email").
description.zh: 通过 SMTP 以邮件发送核心和其他插件的通知（通知渠道「邮件」）。

description.en: Sent through the SMTP server set in the mailer's settings.
description.zh: 经邮件插件设置中的 SMTP 服务器发送。

reason.en: Connect to the configured SMTP server (enforced when the egress policy is an allowlist)
reason.zh: 连接设置中的 SMTP 服务器（出口策略为白名单时生效）
